The compiler applies each merge by whoever holds more of its region, so the two mirrored merges cancelled: the first moved the Beiyang land to this state, the second moved this state's whole 1928 land back to the Republic of China, leaving the ledger with 1 cell in 1929 against a keyframe of 34,991 (snaps of 1928 and 1929). notes: Page budget (5) spent on the Kuomintang, Northern Expedition, Constitutional Protection Movement, Nanjing decade and Beiyang government pages. WHAT THE ROW IS: Cliopatria's 'Kuomintang' 1917-1929 shapes are country-wide outlines (a gazetteer cross-check shows 1917 covering Beijing, Shandong, Jiangsu and most provinces except Yunnan, Tibet and part of Manchuria; 1924 omits Beijing and Jiangsu; 1926 omits Yunnan, Guizhou and Qinghai). They are not the KMT's land: the KMT held Guangdong from 1917 to 1925. Verdicts 1917-1924 are therefore 'wrong' with Guangdong as the correction, and the country-wide land of those years is carried by republic-of-china (new keyframes 1917, 1926, 1927: the Beiyang Republic minus the KMT's land). Both rows share the Seshat id cn_chinese_rep; the two dossiers are linked by the 1928 merge and the 1929 dissolve events. Not on the pages: the National Government at Guangzhou (July 1925), the dates of the Nanjing government's recognition, the extent of the Wuhan government, Anhui and Jiangsu in 1927, Guangxi's pledge date, the Nationalist control of Sichuan, Yunnan and Guizhou (left out as warlord land), and the Northeast Flag Replacement beyond Zhang Xueliang's allegiance. Counterparts needing dossiers (ea-08-x, the warlord cliques): Old Guangxi clique (Cen Chunxuan, Lu Rongting, 1917-1920), Chen Jiongming's Guangdong army (1920-1923), Guangxi clique (Li Zongren, 1925-1930), Guominjun (Feng Yuxiang), Shanxi clique (Yan Xishan), Fengtian clique (Zhang Zuolin and Zhang Xueliang), Zhili clique (Sun Chuanfang, Wu Peifu). Their names are used as counterpart strings, not slugs. End year 1929 is Cliopatria's; the regime continues as the Republic of China. Capital 'Wuhan' (left KMT, January to 1927) is not listed as a capital because the Nanjing government was the national one. REPAIR 2026-10-20 (ea-08-c, after review): (1) DECISION on 1918-1920: the state is the Guangzhou southern government, which keeps Guangdong throughout (keyframes 1917-1925 unchanged); the May 1918 loss and the November 1920 gain are removed, and the Guangdong-Guangxi War of August-November 1920 stays as a contest with the Old Guangxi clique (ea-08-x should not give that clique Guangdong as a separate state for 1918-1920, or must book it as the government's controlling faction). (2) The 1928 rename is now a merge with republic-of-china, carrying the Beiyang remainder of the Republic's corrected 1927 keyframe, on 29 December 1928 as in the Republic's ledger. (3) The Guominjun's Shaanxi and Henan move to May 1927 (Luoyang 28 May; the page puts Feng's alignment with Nanjing on 20 June) and into the 1927 keyframe. (4) The Jinggang base is dated April 1928 (confidence 2). Still thin: the 1929 vassal ends (Central Plains War page: the Guangxi clique broke off relations with Chiang in March 1929 and Feng clashed with him in May 1929, which would end those two tints before December 1929; Shanxi and the Northeast Army stayed allied until 1930), and Guangxi's pledge and the National Government of July 1925 (not on the New Guangxi clique page).
